card.name: Cardiac imaging and wound-closure wording
card.fires_on: Linking or modifying words in the middle of cardiac-function or incision-closure phrases, such as 'using' before imaging, '-induced' before heart dysfunction, and 'adhesive' before surgical strips.

modes.label: Closing an incision
modes.description: Words describing sterile adhesive strips or compression after a procedure.
modes.example: you can use the absorbable sutures and/or the sterile<< adhesive>> surgical strips provided.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like 'protect' and 'guard' and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on connecting words in heart-function and wound-closure instructions.
